title: The City Without Shadows
body: Mara crosses the gate as the tide returns. The keeper follows and names the city Noctis. Its lamps glow, but nobody casts a shadow. The gate has taken a memory: Mara can still see her grandmother’s face, but can no longer hear her laugh.
imageAlt: Mara and the keeper face Noctis beneath a red eclipse

panels.caption: PANEL 01 - THE PASSAGE
panels.narration: The stone doors begin to close. The compass flashes once, then goes cold.
panels.dialogue: The keeper says the gate never forgets a debt.

panels.caption: PANEL 02 - NO SUNRISE
panels.imageAlt: Silent citizens in a city with no shadows
panels.narration: No footprints mark the pale streets. The crimson eclipse hangs motionless above the rooftops.
panels.dialogue: A child asks Mara why her coat moves when she moves.

panels.caption: PANEL 03 - THE SHADOW SPEAKS
panels.imageAlt: A detached shadow faces Mara in an alley
panels.narration: Mara turns toward the wall. Her shadow stays behind, then steps away from the stone.
panels.dialogue: Her shadow whispers: Mara, your shadow remembers what you forgot.

ending: Orin’s coat begins to drip seawater onto dry stones. Two shadows stretch from Mara’s feet in opposite directions. Above Noctis, the crimson moon opens like an eye.
